title: Chapter 3: Last Containment
intro: Final campaign phase. Every decision echoes across neighboring territories; tactical wins are no longer enough without disciplined crisis control.
intro_es: Fase final de campana. Cada decision resuena en territorios vecinos; las victorias tacticas ya no bastan sin un control estricto de la crisis.
primary_goal: Finish a run with at least 7 controlled regions and crisis at 50 or lower.
primary_goal_es: Termina una partida con al menos 7 regiones controladas y crisis de 50 o menos.
epilogue: The chapter closes with a fragile order: your map is unified, but not healed.
